notifications.title: The nightly data audit lands ~3 h late, after the auditor has run
notifications.detail: data-audit.yml is scheduled at 17:00 UTC (22:30 IST), but GitHub started it at 19:45Z on 16 Oct and 20:07Z on 15 Oct. The 23:00 IST auditor therefore always reads the previous night's audit (tonight's file was 22 h old), so a data bug waits an extra day. The workflow itself succeeds.
notifications.fix: Only the owner may edit workflows: in .github/workflows/data-audit.yml change the cron from "0 17 * * *" to "7 13 * * *" (18:37 IST, an off-the-hour minute GitHub delays less). Even 3 h late it then finishes before 23:00 IST. Nothing else needs to change.
